name: Target Lens
description: Customizable target HUD: buffs/debuffs, threat/aggro, boss skill timers and a live cast bar.
author: Stellar

media.caption: Target overlays in a boss fight — HP + break gauge, the effect list (★ = your own), threat/aggro %, and the cast bar.
Grouped settings — display style, effect-source filters, threat, cast bar and boss timers.

fixed: The in-game network ping reads correctly again instead of always showing 0ms.
Towns no longer stay stuck in permanent night — the day/night cycle works normally again.
Boss skill timers no longer briefly flash blank or unknown entries.
